name: GUIDANCE AND EXPERIENCE
text: Free action, once in each of the Sergeant's activations: pick another friendly Scout Squad operative anywhere in the killzone. It gets +1 APL until the end of its next activation.

name: ASTARTES
text: In each of its activations the Sergeant may Shoot twice or Fight twice (not both pairs). With two Shoots at least one uses a bolt weapon. The Sergeant can counteract whatever its order.

name: Heavy Weapon Bipod
text: When the Heavy Gunner shoots with a weapon from its datacard and has not moved this activation (or it is a counteraction), that weapon has Ceaseless; one that already has Ceaseless gains Relentless instead.

name: Grapnel Launcher
text: Whenever the Hunter climbs up, the climb counts as 2 inches of vertical distance however high it goes.

name: Grapnel Assault
text: When the Hunter charges and in that Charge climbs, drops, jumps or passes under Vantage terrain, its melee weapons have Lethal 3+ until the end of that activation.

name: Camo Cloak
text: While shot, the Sniper ignores Saturate and, if it can retain any cover saves, retains one more or retains one as a crit (not stacking with the Vantage improvement).

name: OPTICS
text: Not in an enemy control range. Until this operative next activates, enemies cannot be obscured while it shoots them.

name: TRACK ENEMY
text: Not in an enemy control range. Pick one enemy within 8 inches (no sight needed). Until the end of the turning point friendly Scout Squad operatives shooting it have Seek Light on their ranged weapons.

name: AUSPEX SCAN
text: Not in an enemy control range. Until this operative next activates (or is incapacitated), a Scout Squad operative shooting an enemy within 8 inches of it ignores the obscured status, and an Optics Sniper shooting it also has Seek Light.

name: Adaptive Equipment
text: Once per turning point one friendly Warrior may perform Smoke Grenade, and once per turning point one may perform Stun Grenade, without using your grenade equipment.

name: FORWARD SCOUTING
text: After both kill teams are set up and before turning point 1, make up to six picks from: Redeploy (once), Reposition (twice), Trip Alarm (twice), Booby Trap (once), Tactical Manoeuvre (once), Diversion (once), Devise Plan (once), Designate Target (once). Picks alternate with any opponent that also has pre-battle picks, starting with the setup initiative holder.
